title: 两面旗
blurb_en: The heads of two rival families marry to keep the peace. When she shuts the river gates on his army, he is sure she has chosen her own side.
blurb_zh: 两大家族的主人成了亲，换来了和平。那年冬天，她关上水门，拦住了丈夫的粮船。
